# AI Phone Receptionist

> An AI voice that answers a local service business’s phone calls when the owner cannot pick up: it answers basic questions and books appointments or takes a message. $399 setup + $199/month. A live test call is arranged before any payment; there is no online payment link for this product.

AI Phone Receptionist is a product by Northbeam Builds, a small studio in Austin, TX that builds websites and AI tools for local service businesses. Company site: https://northbeambuilds.com

## What it is

AI Phone Receptionist — for shop owners who can’t pick up while they’re working: it’s a voice that answers your calls, answers basic questions, and books the appointment or takes a message, so callers reach help instead of voicemail.

## Who it is for

For: You miss calls all day because you’re out on jobs.; After-hours callers reach your voicemail and never call back.; You run a one- or two-person shop with no one free to answer the phone.
Not for: You already have a full-time receptionist answering every call.; You need emergency dispatch calls handled with no human involved. Real emergencies and hard calls always go to a person.

## Price

$399 one-time setup + $199/month. First month total: $598. Month-to-month — cancel anytime, no long contract. If we don’t get it live and working as described, you don’t pay the setup fee.
There is NO online payment link for this product on purpose: a live test call is arranged by email before any payment.

## How it works

1. On one short call, we collect your services, hours, prices, and booking rules — and what should always go straight to you.
2. We set up the voice on your number. You hear it on a live test call and approve it before it ever answers a real customer.
3. It answers when you can’t, books the job or takes a clean message — and anything complicated goes straight to a human: you.

## What is included

- Your number set up, your services, hours, and prices loaded.
- Appointment booking into your calendar.
- A message and summary for every call.
- A live test call you approve before launch.
- If we don’t get it live and working as described, you don’t pay the setup fee.

## Questions and answers

- Q: What if a call is complicated, or an emergency?
  A: It goes straight to you. You set the rules on day one: which calls the voice handles, and which ones ring a human, every time.
- Q: Can it book into my calendar?
  A: Yes. It books real open times and you get the booking and a short summary of every call.
- Q: Does it answer at night and on weekends?
  A: Yes, whenever you set it to answer. Many owners use it only when they can’t pick up; it can cover the hours you choose.
- Q: Can I hear it first?
  A: That’s the deal. A live test call happens before any payment.
